blocks.html: For uses denoted with a “P” in Section 32-171 (Use Group VII – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. In C1 or C2 Districts, as well as in C4 through C8 District, laboratories shall be limited to those that comply with the standards set forth in Section 427 of the New York City Building Code, or its successor. However, other laboratories may be permitted by special permit of the City Planning Commission, as set forth in Section 74-171 (Laboratories).
blocks.plainText: For uses denoted with a “P” in Section 32-171 (Use Group VII – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. In C1 or C2 Districts, as well as in C4 through C8 District, laboratories shall be limited to those that comply with the standards set forth in Section 427 of the New York City Building Code, or its successor. However, other laboratories may be permitted by special permit of the City Planning Commission, as set forth in Section 74-171 (Laboratories).

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Economic Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Reorganized use provisions into new use group structure in Sections 32-11 through 32-20; relocated hotel provisions from Section 32-02 to Section 32-153 and health and fitness establishment provisions from Section 32-413 to Section 32-163; incorporated special permit references from Section 32-30 into use group provisions
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to support economic growth and resiliency by providing businesses with additional zoning flexibility to locate and expand
